subject: Post-call: SlateEdge hosted pricing & traffic profile — pilot next steps
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@slateedge.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-06-27T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-call: SlateEdge hosted pricing & traffic profile — pilot next steps

Ethan — thanks for hopping on the call today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment: 

Summary of needs (from your team):
- Primary use: conversational assistant for payments and account lookup (latency sensitive).
- Expected baseline: ~4.2M tokens/month.
- Seasonal/marketing uplift: potentially up to ~5.8M tokens in peak months (you said May/Nov spikes).
- Steady-state concurrency: ~8 TPS.
- Burst profile: spikes to ~45 TPS for short windows (~30–90s); you mentioned an outlier where it hit ~60 TPS for ~2 minutes last month.
- Target unit economics: $/1M tokens in the low-mid single digits (you said $3–$4/1M as an internal target); budget range for an initial pilot: $12k–$18k/mo, with flexibility for a larger pilot.

Redwood observations & preliminary ideas:
- Hosted API is a fast path for pilot; we typically recommend prefix/KV caching + request batching to reduce token volume for FAQ-like interactions (can save 10–25% tokens depending on prompt shape).
- For the burst profile you described, hosted can absorb short spikes; if bursts are sustained we recommend considering Dedicated or a burst-capable reserved pool.

Immediate next steps (proposal):
1) You share the traffic CSV you mentioned (pattern by hour) — we can run a simple simulation to estimate 99th-% TPS and realistic token reduction from caching.
2) We’ll produce a 1-page pilot quote with two pricing scenarios: hosted (with commit discount bands) and Dedicated (for steady high-concurrency).
3) Start the security questionnaire kickoff in parallel (SOC2 artifacts, data retention limits).

Attachments: slateedge_traffic_pattern.csv (please confirm the hourly fields).

If this aligns, I’ll draft the quote and get Dylan to model the unit-econ table. Proposed follow-up: 48–72h turnaround on the preliminary quote.

Thanks —
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0184

[Attachment: slateedge_traffic_pattern.csv (CSV, 28KB)]

From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@slateedge.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@slateedge.ai
Date: 2026-06-27T16:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SlateEdge hosted pricing & traffic profile — pilot next steps

Thanks Grace — appreciate the clear recap. Confirmations / clarifications: 
- Baseline 4.2M is the conservative run-rate for Q3. We expect 4.2M–5.8M variability across quarters (seasonal + campaign-driven).
- Bursts: the 45 TPS windows are common during product launches; the 60 TPS 2-minute event is an outlier but not impossible. We need the system to stay healthy in those cases.
- Budget: our procurement lead gave an initial band of $12k–$18k for the pilot but can stretch to $20k for the first 2 months if the performance is rock-solid and the SLA aligns.

I attached the hourly export — it's anonymized but should show the burst cadence.

Can you also include in the estimate a line for:
- estimated savings with prefix caching (if you need a sample prompt set we can share one).
- a short note on 99th-pct latency SLOs you think are reasonable for hosted at the volumes above.

Procurement will need the invoice / PO flow and a DocuSign-ready SOW when we agree pricing.

Appreciate it —
Ethan Cole
Head of Product, SlateEdge
ethan.cole@slateedge.ai

From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>

Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, procurement@slateedge.ai
Date: 2026-06-28T09:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call: SlateEdge hosted pricing & traffic profile — pilot next steps

Ethan — thanks for the file, I reviewed the hourly export and looped Dylan in to model a few scenarios. Key notes and a very rough cost sketch to help procurement decide quickly: 

Traffic & token assumptions (from the CSV + call):
- Median monthly tokens: 4.2M
- Peak monthly tokens (campaign months): 5.8M
- Steady TPS: 8 TPS; recurring daily micro-bursts to 30–50 TPS lasting < 2 minutes; occasional 60 TPS outliers.

Caching impact (based on similar customers):
- Prefix caching + short-term KV cache: estimated token reduction 12–18% for your prompt shapes (we'll refine with sample prompts).

Preliminary hosted pricing sketch (illustrative only):
- List price band: $4.5 / 1M tokens
- With a 20% commit discount (pilot band), estimated effective: $3.6 / 1M tokens
- At 4.2M tokens -> ~$15.1k/mo; at 5.8M tokens -> ~$20.9k/mo
- If caching reduces tokens by 15% effective tokens -> 3.57M -> ~$12.9k/mo at $3.6/1M (example).

Notes on peak TPS & SLA: hosted can sustain short spikes, but if spikes become longer than ~5 minutes we recommend a small Dedicated pool or burst reserve. We can commit a 95th/99th latency SLO for the pilot (Dylan will propose specific ms targets after running the traffic sim).

Attachments: redacted_prelim_pricing.xlsx (contains the scenario table with the math above and a companion row showing pricing with/without caching).

Next actions: 
1) We’ll prepare a formal pilot quote with two rows: (A) hosted pilot with commit discount + caching assumptions; (B) Dedicated reserve option (monthly commit).
2) Grace/Dylan to send security kickoff doc (SOC2 artifact list) and a short SOW draft for DocuSign.
3) Procurement: if you can confirm PO/payment flow and preferred invoicing entity, we’ll include that on the SOW.

We aim to deliver the quote + SOW draft by EOD 06/29.

--
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redacted_prelim_pricing.xlsx (XLSX, 42KB)]

From: procurement@slateedge.ai <procurement@slateedge.ai>

Thanks Grace / Dylan — procurement here. We reviewed the sketch and are prepared to move forward with a 2-month pilot under the hosted scenario assuming the final quote sits within the $12k–$20k band (we understand the caching caveat).

Please send: 
- Formal quote and itemized pilot SOW (DocuSign-ready)
- Invoice instructions / PO number template (we will issue PO once SOW is signed)
